entities.summary: Vasyl Vasyliovych Malyuk is a Ukrainian military officer, Lieutenant General, former Head of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) serving from 7 February 2023 to 5 January 2026. He is a member of the National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine and a member of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief’s Staff since 16 August 2022.
